title.zh-TW: 對話裡的網址和檔案連結都能順手點開
title.en: URLs and File Links in Chat Open Effortlessly

body.zh-TW:
在聊天區貼上網頁地址或整理本機文件，過去常遇到連結無法直接開啟的狀況。現在自己打進對話的網址會帶上點擊樣式，外觀跟助手回覆裡的完全一樣。

切換到 Pretty 模式閱讀時，將網址集中列在文章末端的參考式連結，顯示效果也跟直接寫在句子裡的行內連結相同。

就算畫面上正跳出需要確認的卡片，按住 `Cmd` 鍵點擊或用 `Ctrl+click`，照樣可以直接開啟連結。

若路徑裡含有 `%20` 空白編碼，點擊檔案連結現在會打開正確的檔案，不會再誤報找不到檔案。
body.en:
Pasting web addresses or organizing local files in chat used to leave you with links you could not open directly. Now URLs typed in user messages appear as styled clickable links matching assistant links.

When reading in Pretty mode, reference-style links that gather URLs at the end of a message display the same as inline links written directly in a sentence.

Even when the confirmation card is visible on screen, holding `Cmd` and clicking or using `Ctrl+click` still opens links directly.

If a path contains `%20` space encodings, clicking the file link now opens the correct file instead of falsely reporting it missing.

items.original:
Pretty mode shows reference-style links the same as inline links
URLs typed in user messages appear as styled clickable links matching assistant links
`Cmd` or `Ctrl+click` opens links even when the confirmation card is visible
File links containing %20 spaces open the correct file instead of reporting it missing

title.zh-TW: 精簡模式 /mcps 補上來源與工具摘要
title.en: Minimal-Mode /mcps Adds Server Source and Tool Summaries

body.zh-TW:
開著精簡模式用 `/mcps` 指令查閱已接上的 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）清單，以前畫面往往只看得出名字。想確認手邊連了哪幾個外掛服務、它們能做什麼，現在清單會直接標出每個伺服器的來源位置，並附上各自提供的工具摘要。

⟦翻看插座面板時，以前只看到一排插孔卻不知誰接哪條線；現在每個接頭旁都會寫明來源電器跟用途。⟧
body.en:
When checking the list of connected MCP (a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) servers with `/mcps` in minimal mode, the screen used to show only names. If you want to verify which external services are connected and what they can do, the list now labels each server's source location along with a summary of the tools it provides.

⟦When checking a power strip, you used to see only a row of outlets without knowing which cord belonged to what; now each plug is labeled with its source appliance and purpose.⟧

items.original: Minimal-mode `/mcps` list shows server source and tool summaries

title.zh-TW: 修正 Tasks 窗格文字在執行期間閃爍
title.en: Fix Tasks Pane Text Flickering While Work Is Running

body.zh-TW: 把工作交給背景的小幫手執行、一邊盯著 Tasks 窗格看進度，原本上面顯示子代理動態的文字會因為一直更新而閃個不停。這個問題已經修好，現在工作進行期間這段文字不會再跟著閃爍。
body.en: When you handed work off to a background helper and watched progress in the Tasks pane, the subagent activity text shown there used to flicker constantly as it updated. That issue is now fixed, so the text no longer flickers while work is running.

items.original: Tasks pane no longer flickers with changing subagent activity text while work is running

title.zh-TW: 雙擊思考區塊與列表空白處操作恢復正常
title.en: Double-Click on Thinking Blocks and Blank Row Areas Restored

body.zh-TW:
想用滑鼠收合對話裡的內容或調整版面，之前偶爾會碰到點兩下沒反應，或是輕輕一滑就變成反白選取文字的狀況。

現在對著思考區塊（AI 展示推理步驟的摺疊區）連點兩下，又可以正常把它收起來或再展開。

從每一列的空白處拖曳滑鼠，也不會再突然觸發選取文字，也保留原本點擊摺疊或展開的操作。
body.en:
When trying to collapse chat content or adjust the layout with a mouse, double-clicks occasionally stopped responding or a slight drag turned into highlighted text selection.

Now double-clicking a thinking block (the collapsible area where AI shows its reasoning steps) folds or expands it properly again.

Dragging from blank areas of rows no longer triggers a text selection, while preserving the original fold and unfold clicks.

items.original:
Double-click on a thinking block folds or expands it again
Dragging from blank areas of rows no longer starts a text selection and preserves fold/unfold clicks

title.zh-TW: 長檔案路徑縮短後仍看得出檔名或資料夾
title.en: Shortened Long File Paths Keep File or Folder Names Visible

body.zh-TW:
當你把視窗縮窄或進到深層目錄找檔案，原本太長的路徑一旦被截短，往往只剩開頭一串母資料夾、看不出目標是誰。

現在在狹窄欄位裡顯示長檔案路徑，縮短之後依然能辨認出原本的路徑。

切換資料夾選擇器、Persona Source 路徑、How-to Guides 提示與 `@` 檔案搜尋這四處畫面，路徑過長時也都會優先留住最後的資料夾或檔案名稱。

結尾帶有一條或多條斜線的路徑，現在同樣能正確縮短，讓最後一層資料夾名稱保持可讀。

⟦寄快遞在窄標籤上寫地址，以前只印出開頭的縣市區名卻切掉門牌號碼；現在就算欄寬有限，都會留住最後的收件位置。⟧
body.en:
When you narrow the window or dig into deep directories for a file, a truncated long path used to leave only a string of parent folders at the start without showing the target.

Now long file paths shown in narrow columns stay recognizable after shortening.

In four places—the change directory picker, Persona Source path, How-to Guides tip, and `@`-file search—overly long paths now prioritize keeping the final folder or file name visible.

Paths ending in one or more slashes now shorten correctly as well, keeping the final folder name readable.

⟦Picture writing a shipping address on a narrow label: previously only the city and district fit while the street number got cut off, whereas now the final destination always stays visible despite the tight width.⟧

items.original:
Long file paths shown in narrow columns stay recognizable
Change directory picker, Persona Source path, How-to Guides tip and `@`-file search keep the folder or file name visible when a path is too long
Paths ending in one or more slashes shorten correctly and keep the final folder name readable

title.zh-TW: 矮窄終端機上面板不閃退也不截斷提示
title.en: Panels Stay Crash-Free and Hints Intact on Short or Narrow Terminals

body.zh-TW:
把終端機視窗拉得很矮或很窄來對照其他畫面，以前打開搜尋面板容易直接當掉，連按鍵提示也會被硬生生切掉半個字。

現在終端機高度很矮時，打開檔案搜尋面板跟歷史提詞面板都不會再當掉。

在儀表板叫出 `@` 檔案選擇器，就算終端機視窗高度不到 10 列也能正常開啟不閃退。

窄終端機上的權限確認卡片，底下的按鍵提示不會再從英文單字中間被裁斷。

取消回合面板在空間變窄時，現在也會套用正確的文字顏色與刪節號。

⟦整理桌面上的便條紙，以前桌子一換小就整疊滑落或字跡被對折裁半；現在視窗縮得再矮再窄，該看的按鍵字樣都還在。⟧
body.en:
When resizing a terminal window very short or narrow to compare with other screens, opening the search panel used to crash right away and key hints got sliced mid-word.

Now the file-search and prompt-history panels no longer crash when the terminal is very short.

Calling up the `@` file picker in the dashboard now opens without crashing even on terminals shorter than 10 rows.

On narrow terminals, key hints at the bottom of permission cards are no longer cut off mid-word.

The cancel-turn panel now uses the correct text color and ellipsis when space gets narrow.

⟦Think of sticky notes arranged on a desk: a smaller table used to send the whole stack sliding off or fold the writing in half, but now all the key labels stay intact no matter how short or narrow the window gets.⟧

items.original:
The cancel-turn panel uses the correct text color and ellipsis when narrow
Key hints in permission cards are no longer cut off mid-word on narrow terminals
The file-search and prompt-history panels no longer crash on very short terminals
`@` file picker in the dashboard no longer crashes on terminals shorter than 10 rows

title.zh-TW: 選擇器與恢復工作階段卡片的顯示修復
title.en: Display Fixes for Pickers and Resume Session Cards

body.zh-TW:
翻找過去的對話紀錄或從清單挑選項目，過長文字折行、中文字被切半或反白只塗一半，都會讓選單看得很吃力。

恢復工作階段的卡片現在會把過長文字和刪節號留在同一行。

在工作階段選擇器裡看到多行提詞時，刪節號也會跟著顯示在同一列上。

訊息預覽跟選擇器列表遇到中文或全形這類寬字元時，整行文字不會再被截斷。

選擇器裡被選中的項目，現在反白會完整覆蓋整行高度。

在恢復選擇器裡用內容搜尋找到的結果，上方標題也變得更簡短。
body.en:
When browsing past conversations or picking items from a list, wrapped long text, halved wide characters, or half-filled highlights made menus hard to read.

Resume session cards now keep long text and their ellipsis on a single line.

Multi-line prompts in the session picker now show their ellipsis on the same row.

Message previews and picker rows no longer get cut off when encountering wide characters such as Chinese or full-width text.

Selected items in pickers now highlight their full row height.

Content-search results in the resume picker also appear under a shorter heading.

items.original:
Resume session cards keep long text and their ellipsis on a single line
Message previews and picker rows no longer get cut off by wide characters
Selected items in pickers highlight their full height
Content-search results in the resume picker appear under a shorter heading
Multi-line prompts in the session picker show their ellipsis on the same row

title.zh-TW: 擴充功能視窗大小與標籤通知調整
title.en: Extensions Modal Sizing and Label Notice Adjustments

body.zh-TW:
打開擴充功能管理視窗安裝或切換項目，以前框格常比別的視窗窄一截、結果通知也閃一下就消失。

擴充功能視窗現在會維持跟其他彈出視窗一樣的寬度，不會再自己縮窄。

視窗裡標示待處理動作的標籤，開頭字母也統一改成大寫。

操作擴充功能後跳出的結果通知，現在停留顯示的時間跟其他訊息一樣長。
body.en:
When opening the extensions modal to install or toggle items, the frame used to be noticeably narrower than other modals and result notices vanished in a flash.

The extensions modal now keeps the same width as other modals instead of shrinking narrower.

Pending action labels in the modal now consistently start with a capital letter.

Result notices shown after extension actions now stay visible as long as other messages.

items.original:
Pending action labels in the extensions modal start with a capital letter
Result notices after extension actions stay visible as long as other messages
The extensions modal no longer shrinks narrower than other modals

title.zh-TW: 設定與意見回饋視窗的排版和提示改善
title.en: Layout and Hint Improvements for Settings and Feedback Modals

body.zh-TW:
進到設定或意見回饋視窗調整選項時，如果說明文字太長被裁掉，或螢幕太小找不到關閉按鈕，操作很容易卡住。

設定裡的開關與意見回饋訊息，現在改用一致的標籤名稱。

在 `/settings` 裡遇到比較長的設定說明，現在都會完整收進視窗內，不再被邊界切掉。

終端機視窗太小時，意見回饋與設定視窗會直接顯示 `Esc` 鍵提示。
body.en:
When adjusting options in the settings or feedback modals, overly long descriptions getting cut off or not finding a close button on a small screen could easily leave you stuck.

Settings toggles and feedback messages now use consistent labels.

Long setting descriptions in `/settings` now fit completely within the modal without being cut off by the border.

When the terminal is too small, feedback and settings modals now show an `Esc` hint.

items.original:
Settings toggles and feedback messages use consistent labels
Feedback and settings modals show an Esc hint when the terminal is too small
Long setting descriptions in `/settings` fit within the modal without being cut off

title.zh-TW: 指令錯誤與重設匯出通知格式更清楚
title.en: Clearer Command Error and Reset/Export Notice Formatting

body.zh-TW:
執行指令失敗或重設偏好設定，畫面上彈出的提示字句若是寫法五花八門，往往要猜半天才看懂問題在哪。

操作失敗時的錯誤訊息現在會用單一句子帶出原因。執行 `grok -p --resume` 卻一併帶入其他旗標（執行指令時附加的參數開關）而出錯時，提示也比以前清楚。

重設設定跟語音功能出錯時跳出的浮動通知，現在採用一致的格式。

下 `/export` 匯出對話後看到的狀態訊息，樣式也跟其他通知對齊。

多個指令列子指令的輸出訊息，現在統一了標點符號與檔案路徑加引號的方式。
body.en:
When a command failed or preferences were reset, inconsistent prompt wording on screen often forced you to guess what went wrong.

Error messages for failed actions now include the reason in a single sentence. Errors when running `grok -p --resume` with other flags (extra switches passed when running a command) are also clearer than before.

Toast messages shown for settings resets and voice errors now follow a consistent format.

Status messages seen after exporting a conversation with `/export` also match the style of other notices.

Output messages across several CLI subcommands now use consistent punctuation and path quoting.

items.original:
`/export` status messages match the style of other notices
Toast messages for settings resets and voice errors follow a consistent format
Error messages for failed actions include the reason in a single sentence, and errors for `grok -p --resume` when other flags are present are clearer
Several CLI subcommand messages use consistent punctuation and path quoting

title.zh-TW: 歡迎與登入畫面的框線和提示文字調整
title.en: Updated borders and prompt text on welcome and sign-in screens

body.zh-TW:
每次打開工具準備完成帳號驗證，或看看有沒有新版更新，最先見到的幾個操作步驟都更整齊了。

歡迎畫面裡用來輸入授權 token（登入驗證用的令牌）的方框，現在改為圓角外框。

同一個畫面上的更新通知現在對齊方式一致。

歡迎畫面上幾項小提示跟標籤也換成更一致的用字。

登入步驟複製內容後的提示字句，現在固定顯示為 `"Copied!"`、`"Copy sent: verify paste"` 以及 `"Copy failed"`。
body.en:
Every time you open the tool to complete account verification or check for new updates, the first steps you see are now tidier.

The box on the welcome screen for entering your auth token (a credential for sign-in verification) now has rounded corners.

Update notices on the same screen now align consistently.

A few tips and labels on the welcome screen also use more consistent wording.

The messages shown after copying during sign-in now read `"Copied!"`, `"Copy sent: verify paste"`, and `"Copy failed"`.

items.original:
Auth token box on the welcome screen has rounded corners
Update notices on the welcome screen align consistently
A few welcome-screen tips and labels use more consistent wording
Sign-in copy messages read "Copied!", "Copy sent: verify paste", and "Copy failed"

title.zh-TW: 目標視窗與儀表板各區的文字樣式對齊
title.en: Aligned text and styling across goal windows and dashboard sections

body.zh-TW:
在主畫面、目標彈窗或精簡介面之間切換查看進度，原本同一種資訊在不同地方長得不太一樣，看久了容易混淆。

目標疊加視窗裡的待辦清單，現在的樣式跟主待辦窗格完全相同。

狀態列與目標視窗裡顯示的目標狀態標籤，兩邊用字也保持一致。

精簡模式下的計畫核准文字，現在跟全螢幕版本一模一樣。

儀表板底部的頁尾內距變得平均，滑鼠移到位置說明文字上時也會變亮。
body.en:
When switching between the main screen, goal modals, or the minimal view to check progress, the same information used to look different across views, which could easily get confusing.

Todo lists in goal overlays now match the styling of the main Todo pane.

Goal status labels displayed in the status bar and the goal modal now use consistent wording.

Plan approval text in minimal mode now matches the fullscreen version.

The dashboard footer now has even padding, and the location caption brightens on hover.

items.original:
Todo lists in goal overlays match the main Todo pane styling
Plan approval text in minimal mode matches the fullscreen version
The dashboard footer is padded evenly and the location caption brightens on hover
Goal status labels are consistent between the status bar and the goal modal

title.zh-TW: 檔案列表與溢出提示的數量顯示修正
title.en: Fixed item counts in file lists and overflow messages

body.zh-TW:
要看工具一口氣掃出多少檔案，數字一旦算錯或只寫個大概，就很難核對到底有沒有漏。

現在列表工具的每一行都會顯示正確的檔案與資料夾數量。

內容過多時的提示訊息，現在會正確區分英文單複數，並顯示精確的項目數量。
body.en:
When checking how many files the tool scanned at once, miscounted numbers or approximate counts make it hard to verify whether anything was missed.

List tool rows now show the correct number of files and folders.

Overflow messages now pluralize properly and display exact item counts.

items.original:
List tool rows show the correct number of files and folders
Overflow messages correctly pluralize and show exact counts

title.zh-TW: 狀態訊息與預覽尺寸的標點符號統一
title.en: Unified punctuation for status messages and preview dimensions

body.zh-TW:
載入中的三個點、終端機標題大小寫跟圖片尺寸的寫法，過去各處規格不一，現在整套版面的符號格式都整齊了。

載入提示與輸入框預留文字，現在改用統一的 Unicode 刪節號字元。

狀態訊息跟終端機標題也遵循一致的大小寫規則。

對話紀錄裡顯示沒有可重試項目的那一行，結尾不再加上句號。

圖片預覽疊加視窗顯示尺寸時，現在改用乘號標示。
body.en:
The three loading dots, terminal title capitalization, and image dimension formatting used to vary across views, and now symbol formatting is consistent throughout.

Loading messages and input placeholders now use a consistent Unicode ellipsis character.

Status messages and terminal titles also follow consistent capitalization rules.

The transcript line indicating there is nothing to retry no longer ends with a period.

Image preview overlays now use the multiplication sign when displaying dimensions.

items.original:
Loading messages and input placeholders use a consistent Unicode ellipsis character
Status messages and terminal titles follow consistent capitalization
The transcript line for nothing to retry no longer ends with a period
Image preview overlays show dimensions with the multiplication sign
